notes.title: Hotfix - Bioguard 1.0.12
notes.content:
[b][General][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the debuff system in towers on certain occasions.
[*] Fixed the goroguinhos spawn in phase 1 of world 2.
[*] Fixed the refund system in the immunobolto store.
[*] Fixed the order of skills in the phase when configuring the deck.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the game time to be changed at inappropriate times.
[*] Fixed the options panel in the title.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added a feedback animation to new enemy alerts.
[*] Added support for changing gameplay times on the Numpad.
[/list]

- Fixed a bug that allowed the game time to be changed at inappropriate times.
- Fixed the options panel in the title.

- Added support for changing gameplay times on the Numpad.
